نرتكس (form VIII)
# نَرْتَكِسُ (nartakisu) /nar.ta.ki.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَكَسَ (irtakasa)
# نُرْتَكَسُ (nurtakasu) /nur.ta.ka.su/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَكَسَ (irtakasa)
# نَرْتَكِسَ (nartakisa) /nar.ta.ki.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَكَسَ (irtakasa)
# نُرْتَكَسَ (nurtakasa) /nur.ta.ka.sa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
